text:
Marta B: Quick QA needed on PolarWave marketing bundle they uploaded. Link: https://files.redwood.com/polarwave/marketing_v1.zip. Need logo lockups, micro-tile, alt text, and the customer quote cleared for the case study. Target: ready for staging by Thu AM.
Evan (design): Downloaded assets. Two immediate issues: (1) horizontal lockup bleeds at 360px on mobile; add 10px left padding. (2) reversed white SVG has a faint halo in 1x PNGs. Recommend compact mark for thumbnail. Export list: SVG compact, PNG 140x140 + 280x280, hero preview 900x320. CTA suggestion to pass AA on dark: use #004b9e.
Raj P: Partner provided quote: "PolarWave cut inference latency by 28% in production." They want short attribution: "- Maya Lin, Chief ML Engineer, PolarWave". Sofia, legal ok?
Sofia (legal): Need signed quote consent and confirmation of exact title. Also request partner's formal company name for announcement headline. If they send signed consent PDF, we're clear.
PolarWave Ops: Confirmed: formal name is "PolarWave Systems, Ltd." and title is correct. Uploaded signed consent (PW-2026-AG) and a clean SVG set to the shared folder. Also added a compact mark SVG. Link: https://files.redwood.com/polarwave/exports.
Evan (design): Great. I'll re-export PNGs without halo, increase left padding on horizontal lockup, and center compact mark for 140x140. Adding alt text metadata file to the folder.
MarketplaceBot: Reminder: marketplace microtile constraints: 140x140 thumbnail, title <= 60 chars, short desc <= 140 chars, alt text <= 125 chars. Also automated AA contrast run on CTA during staging.
Marta B: For copy, propose:
- title: PolarWave Systems, Ltd. 1 Low-latency inference integrations (55 chars)
- short_desc: Joint solution delivering 28% lower inference latency and predictable throughput for LLMs (102 chars)
- alt_text: PolarWave compact mark  low-latency inference hardware and software for production LLMs (88 chars)
PolarWave Ops: OK on copy and quote. Localization for FR/DE will follow by EOD tomorrow.
Sofia (legal): Consent validated, no IP issues. Please use full legal name in headlines per brand guide.
Evan (design): Uploading revised exports and metadata now to the exports link. CTA set to #004b9e.
Raj P: I'll update case study card attribution to: "Maya Lin, Chief ML Engineer, PolarWave Systems, Ltd." and paste final strings in marketplace form after exports complete.
Marta B: Final checklist: 1) Evan uploads revised PNG/SVG + metadata; 2) Raj posts marketplace strings and schedules staging; 3) PolarWave Ops provides localized copy (FR/DE); 4) Sofia verifies consent (done). Ping this thread when staging is green and we'll approve publish. :white_check_mark:
